label: Diagram 33
caption: Diagram 33 Ventilation for flueless gas appliances | Size of natural draught flues for open-flued appliances
description:
The page is headed "Diagram 33 Ventilation for flueless gas appliances". At the top is a plan view of a room. A rectangle with diagonal lines is shown in the top wall, representing an openable window, door or similar form of controllable ventilation. An arrow from the text "Permanently open vent opening directly to outside with free area not less than that given in Column 4 of the table below" points to a gap in the left wall. Text at the right, "In accordance with Approved Document F: a) openable window, door or similar form of controllable ventilation opening directly to outside; or b) for a kitchen, mechanical extract ventilation", points to the openable element in the top wall. Text below the plan, "Flueless appliance with a rating not exceeding that given in Column 2 of the table below", points to a rectangle containing vertical lines at the lower right, representing the flueless appliance.

Beneath this is a table titled "Free areas of permanently open air vents". The columns are "Flueless appliance type"; "Maximum appliance rated heat input"; "Volume of room, space or internal space (m³)"; and "Free area of permanently open air vent (mm²) (3, 4)". The first row is "Cooker, oven hotplate or grill or combination thereof"; maximum rated heat input "Not applicable"; volume "<5", "5 to 10", ">10"; free areas "10,000", "5,000 (8)", and "No permanently open vent needed". The second row is "Instantaneous water heater"; maximum rated heat input "11kW (net)"; volume "5 to 10", "10 to 20", ">20"; free areas "10,000", "5,000", and "No permanently open vent needed". The third row is "Space heater not in an internal space (3, 4)"; maximum rated heat input "0.045kW (net) per m³ volume of room (5)"; volume "all cases"; free area "10,000 PLUS 5,500 per kW input (net) in excess of 2.7kW (net)". The fourth row is "Space heater in an internal space (3, 4)"; maximum rated heat input "0.090kW (net) per m³ volume of internal space"; volume "all cases"; free area "10,000 PLUS 2,750 per kW input (net) in excess of 5.4kW (net) (7)".

Below the table are eight numbered notes. The first note says: "The permanent ventilation provisions listed in this table are additional to the openable elements or (for kitchens only) extract ventilation in accordance with Approved Document F." The second note says: "Divide the area given above in mm² by 100 to find the corresponding area in cm²." The third note says: "An internal space here means one which communicates with several other rooms or spaces. An example would be a hallway or landing." The fourth note says: "For LPG fired space heaters conforming to BS EN 449:2002+A1:2007, follow the guidance in BS 5440-2:2009." The fifth note says: "No permanently open vent is needed if the room or space has a door direct to outside." The sixth note says: "Example: for a space heater in a lounge measuring 4m x 4m x 2.4m (= 38.4m³), the appliance rated input should not exceed 38.4 x 0.045 = 1.73kW (net)." The seventh note says: "Example: a hallway containing a space heater with a rated input of 7kW (net) should have a permanently open vent with equivalent area of: 10,000 + 2750 x (7 – 5.4) = 14,400mm²." The eighth note says: "No permanent opening required if the room has a door that opens directly to outside."

The page is headed "Diagram 33 Ventilation for flueless gas appliances". At the top is a plan view of a room: a square with a diagonal cross (a door) at the top, and a rectangle containing vertical lines (the appliance) at the lower right. An arrow from the text "Permanently open vent opening directly to outside with free area not less than that given in Column 4 of the table below" points to a gap in the left wall. Text at the right, "In accordance with Approved Document F: a) openable window, door or similar form of controllable ventilation opening directly to outside; or b) for a kitchen, mechanical extract ventilation", points to the door. Text below, "Flueless appliance with a rating not exceeding that given in Column 2 of the table below", points to the appliance.

Beneath this is a table titled "Free areas of permanently open air vents" with columns: Flueless appliance type; Maximum appliance rated heat input; Volume of room, space or internal space (m³); Free area of permanently open air vent (mm²) (3, 4). Rows list cooker, oven hotplate or grill or combination thereof (Not applicable); instantaneous water heater (11kW (net)); space heater not in an internal space (0.045kW (net) per m³); and space heater in an internal space (0.090kW (net) per m³), with vent areas of 10,000, 5,000, "No permanently open vent needed", or additions of 5,500 / 2,750 per kW. Eight numbered notes follow at the foot.

check.note: Table row for instantaneous water heaters: the volumes are 5 to 10, 10 to 20 and >20; it gives ">10" for the middle one.
